zh.noCoverNote: 先查看交付清单、详细说明与许可范围，确认是否适合你的需求。
zh.coverNote: 发布者提供的封面，交付范围以清单和所选档位为准。
zh.previewNote: 提供了演示或源码时，可在这里打开查看。
zh.tiersNote: 对比每档包含的内容，购买时以实际选择的档位为准。
zh.runCostBoundary: 该商品绑定可执行工作流。运行时另行确认算力费用，浏览页面不会启动任务。
zh.freeCostBoundary: 此条目免费分享。外部产品的账号、托管、模型或增值服务费用由原作者规定，免费分享不代表外部服务全部免费。
zh.deliveryNote: 需求、交付内容和修改在对应订单中沟通；超出已发布范围的要求需要重新确认。
zh.orderProcessNote: 选择档位并创建订单，支付后提交需求，发布者交付后核对成果。需要修改或存在争议时，在订单内按当前状态处理；确认交付后结算。
zh.versionNote: 本页展示已发布的第 {version} 版。订单绑定创建时的版本与报价，后续页面更新不会替换已有订单约定。
zh.workflowVersionNote: 运行绑定工作流第 {version} 版，启动前会再次校验。
zh.runPreparation: 填写自己的真实资料，核对本次费用并明确确认后再启动。成果保存在你的运行记录中。
zh.purchasePreparation: 先核对交付清单和许可，创建订单后在订单内完成支付与需求沟通。
zh.runPriceNote: 运行前确认实际算力费用。
zh.freePriceNote: 免费查看或获取，外部服务规则另见原作者说明。
zh.pointsPriceNote: 这是站内积分报价，现金报价以另行显示的支付选项为准。

en.noCoverTitle: The publisher has not provided a cover
en.noCoverNote: Read the deliverables, full description and license to decide whether this fits your needs.
en.coverNote: Publisher-provided cover. The deliverables and selected tier define the delivery scope.
en.previewNote: Open the demo or source here when the publisher has provided one.
en.tiersNote: Compare what each tier includes. Your selection at checkout determines the order scope.
en.runCostBoundary: This listing binds an executable workflow. Compute costs require confirmation before a run; opening this page does not start a task.
en.freeCostBoundary: This listing is shared for free. External accounts, hosting, models and premium services follow the original provider's terms. A free listing does not make every external service free.
en.deliveryNote: Discuss requirements, delivery and revisions in the order. Requests beyond the published scope require a new agreement.
en.orderProcessNote: Choose a tier and create an order, pay and submit requirements, then review the publisher's delivery. Request revisions or report a dispute in the order as its status allows. Settlement follows delivery acceptance.
en.versionNote: This page displays published version {version}. An order binds the version and quote at creation; later page updates do not replace an existing agreement.
en.workflowVersionNote: Runs bind workflow version {version}, which is checked again before execution.
en.purchaseHeading: Confirm a tier and create an order
en.runPreparation: Enter your actual information, review the cost and explicitly confirm before starting. Results stay in your run history.
en.purchasePreparation: Check the deliverables and license first. After creating an order, complete payment and discuss requirements there.
en.runPriceNote: Confirm the compute cost before running.
en.freePriceNote: Free to view or obtain. External service terms are set by the original provider.
en.pointsPriceNote: This is a marketplace points quote. Any cash price appears separately in its payment option.
en.chooseAndBuy: Choose a tier and view checkout
